name: Auto-Wall
tagline: Automatically detect walls in TTRPG battle maps and export to VTTs
description: Auto-Wall transforms tabletop battle map images into ready-to-use wall, door, and lighting data for FoundryVTT, Roll20, Fantasy Grounds, and other virtual tabletops supporting the Universal VTT (UVTT) standard. Computer vision and edge detection eliminate tedious manual tracing.
features: Automated wall detection powered by computer vision and threshold filters
Export to Universal VTT (.dd2vtt / .uvtt) for FoundryVTT and Fantasy Grounds
Interactive point editing to tweak door, window, and secret wall placements
Batch processing for multi-room dungeon crawl maps
